The AD applies to Boeing Model 737-8 and 737-9 airplanes.

Southwest Airlines' 737 MAX 8 fleet was compliant with FAA AD 2020-05-11 (all 87 aircraft, pre-service compliance November 2020) and FAA AD 2022-03-07 (all 87 aircraft, completed April 2022). FAA AD 2024-01-02 requires installation of MCAS Software version 2.0 or later within 90 days after the AD's effective date of February 15, 2024, along with an FCOM revision, AOA sensor inspection, and compliance reporting. MCAS Software v2.0 supersedes v1.7.3 and all earlier versions, and operators must not operate 737-8 or 737-9 aircraft with v1.7.3 or earlier after the AD's compliance date.
